info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Mortgage Loans Payoffs-v3-spec
info.description: The List Mortgage Loan Payoffs API enables users to retrieve detailed information about mortgage loan payoffs. This endpoint serves as a key resource for financial institutions and lending agencies looking to track the status and amount of loan payoffs. Typical consumers include loan officers, financial analysts, and mortgage servicers who require transparency and accuracy in loan transactions. By providing comprehensive payoff data, this API supports effective management of loan portfolios and fosters informed decision-making.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the payoff amount for loans, providing insights into the total amount needed to settle the loan early.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the payoff information for loans. It should include all necessary details required to process the request.

201.description: Payoff request processed successfully, resource created.

ListMortgageLoansPayoffsRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the payoff operations in the loans API. It is expected to contain a JSON-encoded string.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number for the transaction.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: Current state of the loan payoff operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: Informational message related to the operation.

ListMortgageLoansPayoffsResponse_201.description: Response schema for the GET operation on loan payoff. Contains status, reference number, result ID, state of the operation, processing time, a message, and audit details.

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user who created the entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp of when the entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the operation was performed automatically.

AuditDetails.description: Audit details related to the loan payoff operation.

x-processing-time.description: The amount of time, in milliseconds, that the server spent processing the request. This value is useful for performance monitoring and optimization.
